Antidotes, huh? I didn't know

Alright...I've investigated this room thoroughly.

<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't find any evidence to
suggest Kaito isn't dead...

<CLT=cltMIND>On the contrary, there's plenty of
evidence to suggest *Kokichi* isn't dead.

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma is still moving around,
and the killing game hasn't ended.

<CLT=cltMIND>And...Kaito's clothes were in
the hydraulic press...
<CLT=cltMIND>Which means...the victim must be...

No, it's too soon to be thinking like that.
If I investigate a little more, I'll find something.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's still time...
I should head back to the hangar.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps I missed something...
I should check again.
